                <summary>How to read the control log</summary>
                <p>Each row is a command someone queued (from the command line or the dashboard) and the single outcome the supervisor recorded for it. A command is only a request until the supervisor records it; refused, out-of-date and not-applied commands changed nothing. The supervisor keeps only the latest 200 commands.</p>
